title: Jev questions
description: Any set of Jev questions, in Jev's own request shape. One schema for every Jev call in the codebase. Code does not know the question names; it forwards the questions and stores each answer as a context attribute. Deliberately loose: criteria differs per question type (noul: {true,false}, score: string[], choice: {label: description}) and the tooling does not enforce oneOf yet.

criteria.description: noul: {true, false} descriptions. score: ordered rubric, 2 to 10 strings. choice: {label: description}.
